address: Mill Road, Stoke Mill, Stoke Holy Cross, NR14 8PA, United Kingdom
bio: Nestled inside the Stoke Mill Restaurant – itself located in a beautiful ancient mill – this intimate and personal experience sees the chefs serving just 14 diners. As they proudly explain each well-honed dish, you feel like you’ve been welcomed into a private home. The consistently impressive tasting menu makes great use of top-quality ingredients, often enhanced with delicate yet deeply flavoured sauces – a prime example could be monkfish rubbed with Baharat spice mix and finished with a beurre blanc based on tomato water reduction.
